messages:
Nora: heads-up — promo for release v2026.04.2 is blocked in the 14:00 UTC window. several runners fail during image-extract with mismatched layer length errors. deploy-bot auto-held the promo.
Tim: error sample: "layer-5: unexpected content-length (got 0 bytes mid-stream)". affects ap-northeast and eu-west runners only. registry shows the expected size.
DeployBot: Alert — promotion auto-hold
  promo-id: 8732
  failed-step: image-extract
  sample-runner: eu-west-2-runner-7
infra-bot: Observability — origin edge returned HTTP 206 with short content-length for range requests between 1766666880-1766667005. 3 distinct edge nodes reported reassembly retries.
Tim: sounds like range reassembly/edge cache bug. builder upload claims success so registry may be fine but edge is serving bad ranges.
QA-bot: quick check: previous artifact v2026.04.1 passes smoke on affected runners. recommendation: pin to previous artifact to keep the change window.
Nora: options: (1) manual-promote previous tag (fast) (2) reupload blobs from builder host (fast but risk partial copies) (3) rebuild+push (safe but may miss window). I'm leaning to pin-old + follow-up infra ticket.
ReleaseLead: agree pin-old, but run acceptance on pinned artifact before promoting. add a release note explaining the temporary pin. open infra ticket to track edge reassembly.
Tim: creating manual-promote PR now and attaching edge logs + blob verify steps. PR: PR-1993. Command: `/deploybot manual-promote PR-1993 lock-window 60m pin v2026.04.1`
DeployBot: Manual promote request created; status: awaiting approval.
QA-bot: running acceptance on v2026.04.1 -> PASS on eu-west & ap-northeast. No extract errors observed.
ReleaseLead: approved. DeployBot: execute PR-1993 when ready and mark release_notes: "Canary pinned to v2026.04.1 due to range reassembly errors at CDN edge; rebuild/reupload and infra follow-up INF-1704 scheduled."
infra-bot: Observability update — edge reassembly errors subsided at 1766667110. Opened INF-1704 and assigned to edge-team.
Nora: thanks everyone. keeping window locked for 60m. we'll retry full promo once INF-1704 confirms fix or after rebuild.
